entities.summary: Wang Shouguan was a Chinese astronomer, president and honorary president of the Chinese Astronomical Society. He was hailed as one of the founders of modern astrophysics and radio astronomy in China. He was a delegate to the 5th, 6th, 7th and 8th National People's Congress.
